description: Used cars for sale at Spanish dealers right now, each with its price against the usual price of comparable cars (cheap, fair or expensive) and the page to see it. Turn the user's request into the filters: words for make, model, version or fuel go in query ("Toyota Corolla híbrido"), and price, year, mileage and province in their own fields. Results come cheapest against the market first unless sort says otherwise.

fuel.description: Optional: Gasolina, Diésel, Híbrido, Híbrido enchufable, Eléctrico, GLP or GNC

limit.description: How many cars, 1 to 20; 8 if not given

max_price.description: Highest asking price in euros, optional

min_price.description: Lowest asking price in euros, optional

query.description: Make, model, version or fuel words, e.g. "Golf GTI"

sort.description: market (cheapest against its market first, the default), price, year (newest first) or km

name: search_cars
title: Search used cars for sale in Spain
